name: statusline
description: A vim-style status bar in the Claude Code footer: editor mode, permission mode, model, effort, git state, usage and cursor; numbers the draft's lines and keeps the prompt box taller.

lineNumbers.title: Number the draft's lines
lineNumbers.description: In the fullscreen renderer, draw each line's number over the two-cell gutter of the prompt box, in place of the prompt's own mark. Off leaves the gutter as Claude Code draws it.

minLines.title: Rows the prompt stands at the least
minLines.description: In the fullscreen renderer, keep the prompt box this many rows tall while its draft is shorter: blank rows are drawn under the draft and the box's rule under them. 1 leaves the box as Claude Code sizes it.

expandedLines.title: Rows the prompt stands at while expanded
expandedLines.description: In the fullscreen renderer, /expand (bound to a key as command:expand, or :expand in the vim mod's command line) stands the prompt box this many rows tall until the next prompt is sent, or until it is run again. Claude Code lets the box grow to half the screen less five rows, which is as tall as it stands with the default. Never fewer than minLines.

git.title: The git branch and the lines changed
git.description: Show, before the usage at the end of the footer, the branch the working copy is on and the lines added and deleted in its tracked files since the last commit, as git diff --numstat HEAD counts them. Read every five seconds and after each tool call.
